questions.q: How many buckets does LTTB use for a target of 100 points?
why: Correct: first and last are kept separately, so threshold − 2.

questions.q: A = (0, 0), B = (1, 2), C = (2, 0). What is the triangle area? (base 2, height 2)
Scenario: the product team wants the downsampled chart to also show the exact mean of the full data. What do you say?
options: LTTB is for display; compute the mean on the full data
Compute the mean of the sampled points

questions.q: Scenario: after LTTB the first point of the chart is missing. What is the bug?
options: The first point was not added to the output
why: Correct: always add index 0 and n − 1.
Bucket size does not remove the first point.

questions.q: What is the time complexity of LTTB?
why: Correct: each point is a candidate once, and each bucket average is computed once.
There is no nested pass over all points.

questions.q: Scenario: you zoom into a small part of the chart. What should the server do?
options: Re-downsample the raw data of that range
why: Correct: keep the raw data and downsample per view.
You would see too few points.
